name: HEYwire
description: Low-voltage cabling for hotels and resorts, healthcare, senior living, restaurants, retail, and showrooms. Same-day quotes, straight pricing, and a crew on the calendar.

steps.title: Quote
steps.text: Tell us the property and the job. A fixed price comes back in writing, usually the same day. Complex projects, the next.

steps.title: Schedule
steps.text: Pick a window that works around your guests, patients, or customers. We hold it the moment you confirm.

steps.title: Dispatch
steps.text: A crew is on the way with the work order, the materials, and your price already agreed.

proof: We work around guests, never through them. Quiet crews, clean runs, nothing left in a hallway.
Every run certified, labeled, and documented. You get the test results, not just an invoice.
One HEY covers six drops or six hundred rooms. Same pricing logic, same crew standard.

services.title: Structured cabling
services.short: Cat6 and Cat6A drops, patch panels, and the closets that tie them together.
services.text: New drops, relocations, or full closet builds. Every run is tested to category spec, labeled at both ends, and documented in a hand-off report. Add as-built drawings if you want the map, too.

services.title: Fiber backbone
services.short: Single-mode and multimode between buildings, floors, and closets.
services.text: Riser and campus fiber, terminated, labeled, and tested. We help you plan for the next ten years, not the next ticket.

services.title: Wi-Fi access point drops
services.short: Cabling and mounting for guest and back-of-house wireless.
services.text: Drops to every AP location on your heat map, mounted and patched, ready for your network team (or ours) to bring online.

services.title: Cameras and access control
services.short: Cabling for cameras, card readers, and intercoms.
services.text: Clean runs to every camera, reader, and intercom location, with the low-voltage power and data your security integrator specifies. We coordinate directly with them so nothing gets pulled twice.

services.title: AV and digital signage
services.short: Meeting rooms, ballrooms, lobbies, and menu boards.
services.text: HDMI, control, audio, and network cabling for the rooms where things get presented, and the screens that tell guests where to go.

services.title: Guest room technology
services.short: TVs, in-room networking, and in-room devices.
services.text: Room-by-room refreshes on a turnover schedule, with rooms back in inventory the same day. Built for brand tech standards and property management deadlines.

services.title: Closet cleanup and certification
services.short: Bring an inherited MDF or IDF back to something you can trust.
services.text: Trace, label, re-dress, and certify what is already there. You get a closet you can read and a test report for every run. As-built drawings are an optional add-on.

services.title: Moves, adds, and changes
services.short: Small jobs, fast. A few drops, a relocated desk, a new reader.
services.text: The jobs nobody wants to bid. Say HEY, get a price, and pick a window. Same crew standard as the big ones.

faq.q: How fast does the quote come back?
faq.a: Usually the same business day. Complex projects, such as fiber between buildings or a full property refresh, take until the next day because a person checks every line before it goes out. Either way, it arrives in writing with a fixed price.

faq.q: How can you quote without a site walk?
faq.a: Standard jobs in standard buildings follow patterns we have priced hundreds of times. You tell us the property type, the service, the count, and the location, and we price it from there. Site plans or drawings help, so attach them if you have them. Anything unusual gets flagged for a walk before we commit to a number.
Yes, for 30 days from the quote. If we find something on site that changes the scope, we stop and show you the change before doing the work. No surprise line items on the invoice.

faq.q: Can you work nights and turnover days?
faq.a: That is most of what we do in hospitality, and it carries over to clinics, dining rooms, and sales floors. Pick the window when you schedule, and the crew plans around it.

Best of breed, and we are picky. HEYwire crews are our own: seasoned low-voltage pros, fully insured, and at home in buildings full of guests. They show up on time, in uniform, briefed on your property, and they look like they belong there.

faq.q: What do I get when the job is done?
faq.a: Certification results for every run, labels at both ends, and a clean site. As-built drawings showing where everything goes are an optional add-on, priced on the quote.

faq.q: Do you handle the network gear too?
faq.a: We install and cable it. If you need configuration, we work alongside your IT team or integrator. If you don't have one, we work with the best and can recommend or intro you in.
